HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive.

HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive.
HAS_PROPER_TEMPORAL_PART: B has proper temporal part c =Def c proper temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'proper temporal part of'.

HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'temporal part of' of a Process is a Process.

BEFORE: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the first instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'after'. Transitive.

CAUSES: Relation between a process or event and another process or event that holds when the first has a post material state that is also a pre material state in virtue of which the second is initiated.

MEETS: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as the first instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'met by'.

MODULATES: Relation between a process and another process that holds when the first overlaps the second in time and every state changing temporal part of the first causes some temporal part of the second.

OCCURS_DURING: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is later than the first instant of the temporal extent of j and the last instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the last instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'contains occurence of'. Transitive.

OCCURS_SIMULTANEOUSLY_WITH: Relation that holds between two time instants when they are simultaneous or between two intervals when they have same first and last instants or between two processes or two process boundaries when their temporal extents are the same. Symmetric. Transitive.

TEMPORALLY_FINISHES: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as the last instant of the temporal extent of j and the first instant of j precedes the first instant of i. Its inverse is 'temporally finished by'. Transitive.

TEMPORALLY_OVERLAPS: Relation that holds between two intervals and processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than and the last instant of the temporal extent of i is later than the first instant of the temporal extent of j, and the last instance of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the last instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'is temporally overlapped by'.

TEMPORALLY_STARTS: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as first the instant of the temporal extent of j and the last instant of i precedes the last instant of j. Its inverse is 'temporally started by'. Transitive.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every SeedTrain has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a CellCultureExpansionProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every 'occurrent part of' of a TemporalRegion is a TemporalRegion.
HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'temporal part of' of a TemporalRegion is a TemporalRegion.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every UpstreamBiomanufacturingProcess has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a BiomanufacturingProductionProcess.

HAS_OCCURRENT_PART: (Elucidation) b has occurrent part c means: c is a part of b & b and c are occurrents. Its inverse is 'occurrent part of'. Transitive. Every ViralFiltration has one or more 'has occurrent part' that is a NanofiltrationProcess.

HAS_PROPER_OCCURRENT_PART: B has proper occurrent part c =Def b has occurrent part c & b and c are not identical. Its inverse is 'proper occurrent part of'. Every AttestingProcess has one or more 'has proper occurrent part' that is a MeasurementProcess.

HAS_PROPER_OCCURRENT_PART: B has proper occurrent part c =Def b has occurrent part c & b and c are not identical. Its inverse is 'proper occurrent part of'. Every MaterialTransferProcess has one or more 'proper occurrent part of' that is a PlannedProcess.

HAS_TEMPORAL_PART: B has temporal part c =Def c temporal part of b. Its inverse is 'temporal part of'. Transitive. Every 'temporal part of' of an OneDimensionalTemporalRegion is an OneDimensionalTemporalRegion. Every 'has temporal part' of an OneDimensionalTemporalRegion is one of OneDimensionalTemporalRegion, ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion.

BEFORE: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the first instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'after'. Transitive.

MEETS: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as the first instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'met by'.

OCCURS_DURING: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is later than the first instant of the temporal extent of j and the last instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the last instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'contains occurence of'. Transitive.

OCCURS_SIMULTANEOUSLY_WITH: Relation that holds between two time instants when they are simultaneous or between two intervals when they have same first and last instants or between two processes or two process boundaries when their temporal extents are the same. Symmetric. Transitive.

TEMPORALLY_FINISHES: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the last instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as the last instant of the temporal extent of j and the first instant of j precedes the first instant of i. Its inverse is 'temporally finished by'. Transitive.

TEMPORALLY_OVERLAPS: Relation that holds between two intervals and processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is earlier than and the last instant of the temporal extent of i is later than the first instant of the temporal extent of j, and the last instance of the temporal extent of i is earlier than the last instant of the temporal extent of j. Its inverse is 'is temporally overlapped by'.

TEMPORALLY_STARTS: Relation that holds between two intervals or processes i and j when the first instant of the temporal extent of i is the same as first the instant of the temporal extent of j and the last instant of i precedes the last instant of j. Its inverse is 'temporally started by'. Transitive.

CATEGORIZES: Relation between classifiers in which a higher-order classifier classifies a lower-order classifier and designates a set that has as members only sets designated by lower-order classifiers that it organizes. Its inverse is 'categorized by'.
SPECIALIZES: Relation between two classifiers such that everything classified by the former is also classified by the latter. Its inverse is 'generalizes'. Transitive.

ENDS_AT: Relationship from a process to a spatial region or site whenever the spatial region or site is the location in which the process ends.

g.title: AcceptanceCriteria — Requirement specification that has as parts one or more limits, ranges, or other conditions used to determine whether an entity is acceptable for a specified purpose. Properties: uri
AcceptanceLimitValueExpression — Limit value expression beyond which an acceptance criterion is not satisfied. Properties: uri
AcidBaseIndicatorRole — Molecular color indicator role held by a molecular entity when it is used or planned to be used so that its color indicates the pH range of a material entity. Properties: uri
AcidicChargeVariantPopulation — Protein charge variant population classified by a protein acidic charge variant classifier. Properties: uri
AcidifyingAgentRole — PH adjusting agent role of a material entity when it is used, or planned to be used, to lower pH. Properties: uri

ActionLimitValueExpression — Limit value expression beyond which action is required to address a departure from normal operating conditions and prevent or mitigate potential impact on process performance or product quality. Properties: uri
ActionSpecification — Information content entity that prescribes what participants shall do in a process. Properties: uri
AdherentCellCultureHoldingCapability — Cell culture holding capability to contain an adherent cell culture during a cell cultivation process. Properties: uri
AdherentCellCultureHoldingFunction — Adherent cell culture holding capability that is a function of a material entity. Properties: uri
Adhesion — Relational quality of two material entities that is the extent to which those entities are held together through interactions at their contacting surfaces. Properties: uri
AerationCapability — Gas transfer capability to enable introduction of oxygen-containing gas to a material entity or site. Properties: uri
AerationProcess — Material addition process in which an oxygen-containing gas is added to a defined recipient to provide oxygen or support gas exchange. Properties: uri
AffinityChromatographyMedium — Chromatography medium which has an immobilized ligand as its part which has reversible binding capability to a specific part of a biomolecule. Properties: uri
Age — Quality of a material entity determined by the elapsed time since a specified reference event associated with that material entity. Properties: uri
Agent — Person, group of persons, or engineered system with an agent role. Properties: uri
AgentIdentification — Identifier for a person, group of persons, or engineered system with an agent role. Properties: uri
AgentRole — Role that someone or something has when they act on behalf of a person, engineered system or a group of agents. Properties: uri
AggregateState — Quality of a material entity that is the physical state in which that material entity exists, such as solid, liquid, gaseous, or plasma. Properties: uri
AgitationRate — Rate process profile at which imposed motion is applied to agitate a material. Properties: uri
AgitationRateControllingCapability — Control capability to carry out control of agitation rate. Properties: uri

AlertLimitValueExpression — Limit value expression beyond which an early warning of potential drift from normal operating conditions is triggered, prompting closer monitoring or investigation. Properties: uri

AliquotingProcess — Material sampling process in which a homogeneous material entity is subdivided into multiple portions of defined amount, each portion representing the composition of the source. Properties: uri
AlkalizingAgentRole — PH adjusting agent role of a material entity when it is used, or planned to be used, to raise pH. Properties: uri
AminoAcid — Organic molecular entity that contains a carboxyl group and one or more amino groups. Properties: uri
AminoAcidResidue — Chemical moiety that is a proper part of a peptide or protein and that is the remaining portion of an amino acid resulting from peptide-bond formation. Properties: uri
AminoAcidSequence — Biological sequence that is the ordered pattern of amino-acid residues that constitute a particular continuous peptide or protein molecule. Properties: uri

AmorphousStructure — Physical structure that inheres in a solid material entity by virtue of the material entity lacking the long-range order characteristic of a crystalline structure. Properties: uri
AmountOfSubstance — Quality of a material entity that is proportional to the number of elementary entities of a particular kind present in that material entity. Properties: uri

AnalyticalChromatographySystem — Chromatography system designed to be used in chromatography processes with the primary objective of identifying or quantifying chemical or biological substances. Properties: uri
Anion — Ion that is a monoatomic or polyatomic species having one or more elementary charges of the electron. Properties: uri
AnionExchangeChromatographyMedium — Chromatography medium consisting of a matrix and positively charged molecules that are chemically bound to it. Properties: uri
Antibody — Protein that has the function to selectively bind some antigen. Properties: uri
AntifoamAdditionProcess — Material addition process in which an antifoam agent is introduced into a defined recipient to suppress, reduce, or prevent foam formation. Properties: uri
AntifoamingAgent — Material entity with an antifoaming agent role. Properties: uri
AntifoamingAgentRole — Role of a material entity when it is used, or planned to be used, to reduce or prevent foam formation in a liquid. Properties: uri

AntimicrobialAgentRole — Role held by a molecular entity when it is used or planned to be used to kill, inactivate, or inhibit the growth, proliferation, or replication of microorganisms or viruses. Properties: uri

AntioxidantRole — Role held by a molecular entity when it is used or planned to be used to counteract oxidation or inhibit reactions initiated by dioxygen molecule, peroxides, or other oxidizing species. Properties: uri
Area — Physical size that is the two-dimensional spatial extent of a bearer over a particular surface. Properties: uri

AsepticBarrierCapability — Capability of a material artifact or engineered system to prevent or limit transfer of contaminating material across a physical boundary separating protected material from potential contamination sources. Properties: uri

AtlineMonitoringProcess — Monitoring process consisting of one or more measurement processes that are preceded by a material sampling process, in which material representing the entity of interest is collected from a process stream or in-process material and transferred to analytical equipment located within the same physical area. Properties: uri

AttestingProcess — Planned process to determine the value of one or more qualities, capabilities, and/or process characteristics of an entity of interest in order to verify that they satisfy some requirement specification prescribed by some standard. Properties: uri
BacteriumCell — Cell that lacks a membrane-bound nucleus and has ribosomes of the bacterial type. Properties: uri
BasalCultureMedium — Culture medium which has the basal culture medium role. Properties: uri

BasalCultureMediumRole — Role held by a culture medium when it is used or planned to be used either directly in a cell culture process to provide essential nutritional and physicochemical support or together with supplements to prepare a complete culture medium for such a process. Properties: uri
BasicChargeVariantPopulation — Protein charge variant population classified by a protein basic charge variant classifier. Properties: uri

BatchProcessOperatingMode — Process operating mode of a planned process in which a finite quantity of process material is introduced before or at the start of the main processing interval and processed as a single unit, without additional process material being introduced or removed during that interval. Properties: uri

BatchRun — Manufacturing process that leads to the production of finite quantities of material by subjecting quantities of input materials to an ordered set of processing activities over a finite period of time using one or more pieces of equipment. Properties: uri
BatchRunIdentification — Identifier for a batch run. Properties: uri

BiantennaryComplexNGlycanMoiety — Core pentasaccharide N-glycan moiety that has N-acetylglucosamine residues attached to both the α-3 and α-6 mannose branches and contains no mannose residues beyond those in the conserved core. Properties: uri
Bioburden — Relational quality of a material entity that is the extent to which viable microorganisms are present in or on the surface of the material entity. Properties: uri
BiologicalActivity — Capability of a drug substance, drug product, or relevant process intermediate material to achieve a defined biological effect. Properties: uri
BiologicalSequence — Generically dependent continuant that is the ordered pattern of residues that constitute a particular continuous DNA, RNA, peptide, or protein molecule. Properties: uri
BiologicalSequenceVariant — DNA or RNA or protein or peptide classified by a biological sequence variant classifier. Properties: uri

BiologicalSequenceVariantClassifier — Classifier that classifies a DNA molecule, RNA molecule, peptide, or protein which has a biological sequence that differs from a specified reference biological sequence by one or more substitutions, insertions, deletions, truncations, or extensions. Properties: uri

BiomanufacturingProductionProcess — Manufacturing process in which biological entities such as cells, enzymes, or organisms are used to synthesize, secrete, accumulate, or themselves serve as the target product. Properties: uri
BiomassSpecificProductivity — Manufacturing process productivity whose magnitude is normalized by biomass mass. Properties: uri
BiomoleculePrimaryStructure — Quality of a DNA, RNA, peptide, or protein molecule that is determined by the linear order of its nucleotide or amino acid residues. Properties: uri

BioproductionEnvironmentCapability — Cultivation environment capability to provide a controlled environment in which biological entities generate, or are expanded as, a material product or process intermediate. Properties: uri

BioproductionSupportingFunction — Culture medium specialized function that enables the generation of a target biological product by sustaining cellular activity under production conditions. Properties: uri

Bioreactor — Engineered system designed to provide a controlled environment for the cultivation of cells, tissues, or microorganisms, or for the production of material products or process intermediate materials by those biological entities. Properties: uri

BioreactorVessel — Container designed to contain material undergoing a cell cultivation process and to incorporate or interface with one or more components that provide mixing, aeration, monitoring, or control as part of a bioreactor. Properties: uri

BufferSolution — Solution consisting of a mixture of a weak acid and its conjugate base or a weak base and its conjugate acid which is resistant to pH changes upon addition of an acidic or basic component. Properties: uri

BufferingAgentRole — Role of a material entity when it is added or planned to be added to a mixture, typically aqueous, to enable or enhance the mixture's resistance to changes in pH upon the addition of small amounts of acid or base. Properties: uri
BufferingCapability — Capability of a solution to resist a change in pH when acid or base is added. Properties: uri
BufferingFunction — Function of a solution to resist a change in pH when an acid or base is added. Properties: uri

BulkDensity — Mass density of a particulate material that is the mass per total bulk volume occupied by the material, where the total bulk volume includes particle volume, pore volume within particles, and void volume between particles. Properties: uri
BusinessFunction — Function of an organization to partake in for profit activities as prescribed by the objectives specified by that organization. Properties: uri
BusinessOrganization — Organization engaging in or planning to engage in any activity of buying and selling goods or services for a profit. Properties: uri
CASRegistryNumber — Classifier that is a sequence of digits defined within the Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registry, which classifies a type of chemical substance. Properties: uri
CakingPropensity — Disposition of a particulate material entity to form persistent lumps, agglomerates, or a coherent solid mass. Properties: uri
Capability — Disposition in whose realization some agent has an interest. Properties: uri
CaptureStep — Purification process in which target molecules are selectively and reversibly retained while impurities are allowed to pass through in the flowthrough or wash fractions. Properties: uri
Carbohydrate — Organic molecular entity that is a polyhydroxy aldehyde, polyhydroxy ketone, derivative of such an entity, or condensation product of such entities. Properties: uri
CarbonDioxideEvolutionRate — Rate process profile at which carbon dioxide is produced by cells within a cell culture. Properties: uri
CarbonSourceRole — Nutrient role held by a material entity that provides carbon used by an organism or cell for biosynthesis, energy generation, or both. Properties: uri
CatalogNumber — Classifier that is a sequence of alphanumeric characters created by an organization to classify a product they offer for sale. Properties: uri
Cation — Ion that is a monoatomic or polyatomic species having one or more elementary charges of the proton. Properties: uri
CationExchangeChromatographyMedium — Chromatography medium consisting of a matrix and negatively charged molecules that are chemically bound to it. Properties: uri
Cell — Object of anatomical origin (part of or deriving from an organism) that has as its parts a maximally connected cell compartment surrounded by a plasma membrane. Properties: uri

CellBank — Object aggregate consisting of containers whose contents are uniform portions derived from a single pool of cells and that are stored under defined conditions as a referenceable source of cells. Properties: uri
CellBanking — Planned process of preserving and maintaining a cell line for future use. Properties: uri

CellBleedProcess — Material removal process in which a portion of cell-containing culture material is withdrawn from a cell culture during an ongoing culture process to regulate culture properties such as viable cell density, biomass concentration, or metabolite accumulation. Properties: uri
CellCount — Count that is the number of cells that are present as parts of a material entity. Properties: uri
CellCulture — Material entity that has cultured cells and the media in which they are being propagated or stored as parts. Properties: uri
CellCultureDerivedImpurityRole — Manufacturing process related impurity role held by a material entity that originates from an acellular material component of a cell culture. Properties: uri
CellCultureDoublingTime — Temporal interval over which the size of a cell population doubles. Properties: uri
CellCultureExpansionProcess — Planned cell culture process during which cultivation is managed primarily to increase the total number of cells through cell proliferation. Properties: uri
CellCultureHoldingCapability — Material containment capability to contain material undergoing a cell cultivation process. Properties: uri
CellCultureHoldingFunction — Cell culture holding capability that is a function of a material entity. Properties: uri
CellCultureInoculationProcess — Inoculation process in which a cell-containing inoculum is introduced to initiate a cell culture process. Properties: uri

CellCultureRecoveryProcess — Planned process in which cells that have undergone a stress-inducing process are cultured under controlled conditions to restore or stabilize viability, metabolic activity, or growth potential. Properties: uri
CellDensity — Number density that is the number of cells per unit size. Properties: uri

CellLine — Cultured cell population that is derived from a primary cell source and that has been propagated through repeated subculture under defined conditions, resulting in a genetically stable and homogeneous population of cells with a shared propagation history. Properties: uri
CellLineDevelopment — Planned process in which a cell line is engineered to produce a therapeutic biomolecule or biologic. Properties: uri
CellLineLineage — History of the development of a cell line. Properties: uri
CellPopulation — Object aggregate which only has cells as its member parts. Properties: uri
CellPopulationGrowthRate — Population growth rate of a cell population with respect to change in its number of cells. Properties: uri
CellPopulationProliferation — Process in which cells reproduce or multiply, resulting in an increase in the number of cells. Properties: uri

CellProliferationSupportingFunction — Specialized culture medium function that supports cell division and maintenance of cell viability during expansion culture by providing appropriate nutrients and culture-supporting physicochemical properties. Properties: uri
CellRetentionProcess — Planned process in which material is removed from a cell culture while cells are preferentially kept in or returned to the cell culture. Properties: uri
CellSpecificProductivity — Manufacturing process productivity whose magnitude is normalized by cell amount, typically viable cell amount. Properties: uri
CellSubstrateDerivedImpurityRole — Manufacturing process related impurity role held by a material entity that originates from cells used in a manufacturing process. Properties: uri
CellTherapyProductionProcess — Biomanufacturing production process that results in a cell population which constitutes the targeted product material. Properties: uri
CellViabilityRatio — Relative abundance that is the number of viable cells in a cell population relative to the total number of cells in that population. Properties: uri

CentrifugationProcess — Planned process in which particles such as cells, organelles, or molecules are separated based on size or density by applying centrifugal forces generated by a spinning rotor. Properties: uri
Centrifuge — Engineered system designed to separate materials by subjecting them to centrifugal acceleration generated by rotation. Properties: uri

Certificate — Information content entity that can serve as proof that one or more attesting processes took place to verify that one or more entities satisfy certain requirement specifications. Properties: uri
CertificateGrantingProcess — Planned process of granting a certificate for an entity of interest, preceded by the attestation of that entity. Properties: uri

CertificateOfAnalysis — Certificate that provides quantitative results from analytical tests to verify that the attributes of a specific lot, batch, or individual product satisfy the requirement specifications stated in the certificate. Properties: uri

CertificateOfConformance — Certificate issued by a manufacturer, supplier, or other authorized issuer that attests that a lot or batch or individual material product conforms to specified technical, safety, or regulatory requirements referenced in the certificate. Properties: uri
ChargeVariantClassifier — Classifier that classifies a population of material entities according to charge-related analytical properties relative to a reference material entity. Properties: uri
ChelatingAgentRole — Role held by a molecular entity when it is used or planned to be used to bind a metal ion through two or more coordination sites. Properties: uri
ChemicalMoiety — Material entity consisting of a linked collection of atoms or a single atom and that is a proper continuant part of a molecular entity. Properties: uri
ChemicalSubstanceMaterial — Material entity that is made primarily of one kind of molecular entity, allowing for minor impurities. Properties: uri
ChemicalSynthesisProcess — Manufacturing process in which one or more chemical compounds are created through a set of chemical reactions. Properties: uri

ChemicallyDefinedCultureMedium — Serum free culture medium in which each component and its concentration are known and reproducible, and that excludes undefined components such as serum, extracts, or hydrolysates. Properties: uri

ChemostatCultureProcessOperatingMode — Continuous culture process operating mode in which culture medium containing a growth-limiting component is introduced while culture material is concomitantly removed over an operating interval, with dilution rate used to regulate culture growth. Properties: uri
ChromatographyColumn — Material artifact that is a tube or a cylinder designed to house chromatography medium as the stationary phase during one or more chromatography processes. Properties: uri
ChromatographyMedium — Material entity designed to selectively and reversibly retain different molecules during one or more chromatography processes. Properties: uri

ChromatographyProcess — Planned process that results in the separation of components in a mixture based on their distribution between two phases, one of which is stationary and the other moves in a definite direction. Properties: uri

ChromatographySystem — Engineered system designed to control the fluid flow of the mobile phase, provide monitoring or detection capabilities, and house or interface with the stationary phase for one or more chromatography processes. Properties: uri
Classifier — Denoter that classifies some entity. Properties: uri
CloneSelectionProcess — Planned process in which an optimal set of cell clones is identified and isolated based on the clones exhibiting desirable characteristics. Properties: uri

CloneStabilityStudy — Planned process composed of one or more measurement or monitoring processes, designed to evaluate whether a selected cell clone maintains its key phenotypic characteristics, genotypic traits, and genetic integrity over time and across multiple generations of cell division. Properties: uri
ClonedCellLine — Cell line that originates from a single ancestral cell. Properties: uri
Color — Optical quality characterized by hue, saturation, and intensity. Properties: uri
CompendialGradeClassifier — Material grade classifier that classifies a material entity as conforming to the requirements stated in an applicable pharmacopeial monograph. Properties: uri
CompleteCultureMedium — Culture medium which has the complete culture medium role. Properties: uri

SolutionSaturationState — Material state of a solution in which the dissolved solute concentration stays below, at, or above the solute's equilibrium saturation concentration in that solution under prevailing conditions. Properties: uri
Solvent — Material entity with a solvent role. Properties: uri
SolventRole — Dissolution role held by a material entity that is realized in a process where it dissolves another substance (the solute) to form a solution. Properties: uri
SpecializedCultureMedium — Culture medium that has a specialized culture medium function. Properties: uri

SpecializedCultureMediumFunction — Designed function that inheres in a culture medium and is specified to satisfy the culture requirements of a particular cell type, tissue, microorganism, or cultivation application, often through selective supplements or tailored nutrient formulations. Properties: uri
SpecificCellPopulationGrowthRate — Cell population growth rate whose magnitude is normalized by the size of that cell population. Properties: uri
SpecificSurfaceArea — Quality of a solid material entity that is its total surface area per unit mass. Properties: uri

SpecificallyDependentContinuant — B is a specifically dependent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is some independent continuant c which is not a spatial region & which is such that b s-depends on c. Properties: uri
SpecificationLimitValueExpression — Acceptance limit value expression that is part of a specification. Properties: uri

SpentCultureMediumState — Material state of culture medium that has participated in a cell cultivation process and is characterized by compositional changes caused by cellular activity, process additions, or accumulation of extracellular material. Properties: uri
SpinnerFlask — Flask designed for cultivating cells in suspension that has as part a component with a mixing function to keep the culture uniformly agitated. Properties: uri

SplittingProcess — Manufacturing process in which a batch or lot of a product or intermediate is divided into two or more separately managed portions for further processing, handling, storage or release. Properties: uri
Stability — Capability of a material entity to resist change in one or more of its attributes during a particular process. Properties: uri
StationaryPhase — Material entity with a stationary phase role. Properties: uri

StationaryPhaseRole — Role held by a solid, gel, or liquid that is planned to be or used in a chromatography process as the immobilized material which selectively and reversibly retains solutes in the mobile phase. Properties: uri
SterileMaterialState — Material state in which a participating material entity is free of viable microorganisms. Properties: uri
SterilizationProcess — Planned process in which a material entity is rendered free of all viable microorganisms. Properties: uri
Steroid — Lipid that has a core structure of four fused carbon rings, consisting of three six-membered rings and one five-membered ring. Properties: uri

StockSolutionRole — Role held by a solution that is prepared with an accurately known solute concentration so that measured portions can be diluted to the concentration needed for a particular use. Properties: uri
StorageUnit — Work unit that is a member part of a storage zone. Properties: uri
StorageZone — Work center dedicated to the storage of materials or equipment. Properties: uri

SupersaturatedState — Solution saturation state in which the dissolved solute concentration stays above the solute's equilibrium saturation concentration in that solution under prevailing conditions. Properties: uri

SurfaceTension — Quality of a liquid material entity that is the resistance of the liquid surface to an increase in surface area, arising from unbalanced cohesive forces between molecules at the liquid surface. Properties: uri
Surfactant — Material entity with a surfactant role. Properties: uri

SurfactantRole — Role of a material entity when it is used, or planned to be used, to lower the surface tension of a medium or the interfacial tension between phases by preferentially adsorbing at liquid-vapor or other phase interfaces. Properties: uri
SuspensionCellCultureHoldingCapability — Cell culture holding capability to contain a suspension cell culture during a cell cultivation process. Properties: uri
SuspensionCellCultureHoldingFunction — Suspension cell culture holding capability that is a function of a material entity. Properties: uri
System — Collection of elements (object aggregate) that form a unified whole and interact. Properties: uri

TFlask — Flask designed for cultivating adherent cells that has as part a flat growth surface for cell attachment and a narrow neck for adding or removing material while reducing contamination risk. Properties: uri
TangentialFlowFiltration — Filtration process in which the liquid travels tangentially across the surface of the membrane or bed filter. Properties: uri
TangentialFlowOrientation — Fluid flow orientation that is the tangential orientation of fluid movement in a process with respect to a defined surface. Properties: uri
TappedDensity — Mass density of a particulate material that is the mass per tapped volume occupied by the material after tapping until little or no further volume change is observed. Properties: uri

TargetRangeValueExpression — Range value expression that prescribes a preferred interval for a quality attribute, material attribute, performance indicator, or process parameter at a particular time point or during a particular time interval of some planned process. Properties: uri

TargetValueExpression — Value expression which is a prescribed value that a quality attribute, material attribute, performance indicator, or process parameter should have at a particular time point or during a particular time interval of some planned process. Properties: uri
Temperature — Quality of a material entity whose magnitude characterizes the average thermal energy per microscopic degree of freedom of that material entity. Properties: uri
TemperatureControllingCapability — Control capability to carry out control of temperature. Properties: uri
TemporalInstant — (Elucidation) a temporal instant is a zero-dimensional temporal region that has no proper temporal part. Properties: uri
TemporalInstantValueExpression — Value expression that describes the position of a time instant in the time line. Properties: uri, hasDateTimeInstantValue
TemporalInterval — (Elucidation) a temporal interval is a one-dimensional temporal region that is continuous, thus without gaps or breaks. Properties: uri
TemporalRegion — (Elucidation) A temporal region is an occurrent over which processes can unfold. Properties: uri

ThawingCapability — Capability that an engineered system or material artifact has to provide controlled heating to raise the temperature of a material to a specified setpoint, typically to transition the material from a solid or frozen state to a soft or liquid state. Properties: uri
ThawingFunction — Thawing capability that is a function of a material artifact or engineered system. Properties: uri

ThawingProcess — Planned process in which the temperature of a material entity is raised in a controlled manner to a specified setpoint, typically to transition it from a solid or frozen state to a soft or liquid state. Properties: uri

ThawingSystem — Engineered system designed to raise the temperature of a material in a controlled manner to reach a specified setpoint, typically to transition it from a solid or frozen state to a soft or liquid state. Properties: uri
ThermalStability — Stability that is the capability of a material entity to resist change in one or more of its attributes during exposure to a particular temperature condition. Properties: uri
TotalCellCount — Cell count that is the number of all cells present as parts of a material entity. Properties: uri
TotalCellDensity — Cell density that is the total number of cells per unit size. Properties: uri
TotalMaterialAdded — Process characteristic that is the total quantity of a particular material that is added during a particular process. Properties: uri

TraceElementRole — Role held by a molecular entity composed of a single chemical element that originates from a source external to cells, is present in a small amount, and supports biological processes in those cells. Properties: uri

TraceableResourceUnitRole — Role held by a number of uniquely identified material entities when they participate in some supply chain processes or production processes while some agent observes them and collects information about them for future retrieval. Properties: uri
TransfectionProcess — Genetic transformation process of introducing DNA or RNA into eukaryotic cells by non-viral methods to modify the cell's genetic material. Properties: uri
TransferredMaterialRole — Role held by a material entity when it is being, or is planned to be, physically added to or withdrawn from a material entity or site. Properties: uri
UltrafiltrationProcess — Filtration process in which a membrane filter that is used has pore size in the range of 0.01 to 0.1 μm. Properties: uri

UnsaturatedState — Material state of a solution in which the dissolved solute concentration stays below the solute's equilibrium saturation concentration in that solution under prevailing conditions. Properties: uri

UpstreamBiomanufacturingProcess — Manufacturing process that includes preparation, expansion, cultivation, or propagation of biological material under controlled conditions to produce a process intermediate material or material product. Properties: uri
Validator — Person, organization, or engineered system with a validator role. Properties: uri

ValidatorRole — Agent role held by a person, organization, or engineered system when it assesses the conformance or acceptability of an information artifact, material entity, or planned process against specified criteria. Properties: uri
ValueExpression — Information content entity that contains a value of an entity within a classification scheme or on a quantitative scale. Properties: uri, hasSimpleExpressionValue

VesselHeadspace — Site within the interior of a vessel that is not occupied by the contained bulk material and is bounded by the vessel walls and, when contents are present, by a surface of those contents. Properties: uri
VesselVolumesPerDay — Normalized flow rate whose magnitude is the volume of medium exchanged per day relative to the working volume. Properties: uri
ViabilityStatus — Quality of a biological material entity by virtue of whether that entity is alive and capable of maintaining or recovering relevant physiological activity. Properties: uri
Viable — Viability status of a biological material entity that is alive and capable of maintaining or recovering relevant physiological activity. Properties: uri
ViableCellCount — Cell count that is the number of viable cells that are present as parts of a material entity. Properties: uri
ViableCellDensity — Cell density that is the number of viable cells per unit size. Properties: uri
ViableCellPopulation — Cell population consisting of only viable cells. Properties: uri
Vial — Container that is small, sealable, and designed for holding, storing, or dispensing small quantities of material. Properties: uri
ViralClearance — Manufacturing process that results in the elimination of a target virus by either removing viral particles or by inactivating its infectivity. Properties: uri
ViralFiltration — Viral removal process in which viral particles are physically separated from the input material through a nanofiltration process. Properties: uri
ViralInactivation — Viral clearance during which viral infectivity is reduced by physically or chemically modifying the input material. Properties: uri
ViralRemovalProcess — Viral clearance during which viral particles are physically separated from the input material based on differences in physical properties such as size or charge. Properties: uri
Virus — Minute infectious agent that has a DNA or RNA genome, lacks independent metabolism, and replicates only through use of a living host cell. Properties: uri

VirusInoculationProcess — Inoculation process in which a virus seed or infected host-cell-containing material is deliberately introduced into a cell culture to initiate viral propagation. Properties: uri

VirusSeed — Object aggregate consisting of containers whose contents are portions of a virus preparation derived from a single defined virus source and maintained as a referenceable lot. Properties: uri
Viscosity — Quality of a fluid that is its resistance to shear deformation, manifested as internal friction opposing relative motion between adjacent parts of the fluid. Properties: uri
Vitamin — Organic molecular entity with a vitamin role. Properties: uri

VitaminRole — Role held by an organic molecular entity that is used in small amounts to support metabolic or physiological functions and whose adequate availability depends on external supply or environmental activation. Properties: uri
Volume — Physical size that is the three-dimensional spatial extent of a bearer. Properties: uri

VolumeFraction — Fraction of a material entity that is determined by the volume of a specified material entity or site that is a continuant part of that material entity relative to the total volume of that material entity. Properties: uri
VolumetricFlowRate — Flow rate whose magnitude is determined by the volume of material transported across the specified surface or boundary per unit of elapsed time. Properties: uri
VolumetricProductivity — Manufacturing process productivity whose magnitude is normalized by a specified reference volume of process material. Properties: uri

WaterForInjectionClassifier — Compendial grade classifier that classifies a portion of water that conforms to the requirements stated in a Water for Injection pharmacopeial monograph and thus has very high purity. Properties: uri
WaterMolecule — Inorganic molecular entity consisting of an oxygen atom that is covalently bonded to two hydrogen atoms. Properties: uri
Wettability — Capability of a solid material to be wetted by a liquid. Properties: uri
WorkCell — Work unit that is a member part of a production line and is used to manufacture some material parts that share manufacturing requirements. Properties: uri
WorkCenter — Object aggregate that has piece of equipment or agent as its member parts. Properties: uri
WorkUnit — Object aggregate that is a member of a work center. Properties: uri

WorkingCellBank — Cell bank prepared from cells recovered from one or more containers of a master cell bank and stored under validated cryogenic conditions as a source of cryopreserved cells for routine use in research, development, or manufacturing. Properties: uri

WorkingSolutionRole — Role held by a solution when the solution is prepared from a stock solution or intermediate stock solution at the concentration required for use in a planned process that is not itself a dilution process. Properties: uri
WorkingVolume — Volume that is a quality of process material and that is the volume occupied by that process material in a vessel during a planned process. Properties: uri

YieldPerBiomass — Planned process yield that characterizes the quantity of a specified material output produced in a planned process relative to the quantity of biomass formed in that planned process. Properties: uri

YieldPerSubstrate — Planned process yield that characterizes the quantity of a specified material output produced in a planned process relative to the quantity of a specified substrate consumed in that planned process. Properties: uri
ZeroDimensionalTemporalRegion — (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole consisting of one or more separated temporal instants as parts. Properties: uri
